text: {"label": "Meaningful Lifespan Supports for Autistic People","definition": "Work on supporting autistic children, teens, and adults through social skills and friendships, transition to adulthood and employment, assent, social validity, quality of life, and inclusion of underrepresented autistic groups.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Centres on meaningful, socially valid goals and adult outcomes, not early-intervention efficacy, service-delivery outcome measurement, or applied behavior analysis's broader scope and severe challenging behavior."}
